checks.name: Anonymous requests cannot read or mutate document resources
Incorrect and unknown accounts have the same sign-in error
Editor uploads and viewer retrieves content with matching hash
Viewer writes are rejected by the server even with forged controls
Cross-site and missing-Origin mutations cannot use an editor session
Unknown storage identifiers are not exposed through authenticated reads
Sessions survive API restart and revoked sessions cannot be reused
Cookies are HttpOnly and sessions store token hashes with explicit expiry
Application database credentials cannot administer MongoDB or write another database
Repeated invalid sign-ins are bounded by a shared database budget
